ns2:section.sectionText: Illinois Space Society (ISS) is set to teach a introductory course in High Powered Rocketry and aerospace technical concepts. The course is designed for new students in aerospace and will provide hands-on experience with hardware and software used by the clubs and industry professionals. Students in the course will design a rocket, run tests and simulations of the structure and electronics, and launch the rocket at the conclusion of the course. This course will have its first class meeting on Tuesday, August 31, 2021.
